term: process carrier, continuation preservation and constituent representation
definition: PreservesContinuity s carrier requires carrier p = carrier q for every s.Continuity p q. FixedExtension s carrier parts requires s.MemberAt p c iff parts (carrier p) c: constituents have no time argument. DynamicExtension adds the phase argument to parts. Phase, Component, Scenario and scenario are reused from Mereology.Vitalism. No process is defined as a substance, soul or river.
note: Analyst profile answering the owner river/process question; adequacy for actual rivers remains open. See docs/notes/river-process-turnover.md.
